title: Cognitive Sciences Skeleton v1
description: Coverage skeleton for the cognitive-sciences continent (round 3, strict-sequential depth-first, CPO decision (43) 2026-06-18): field/subfield two-level node set under domain:cognitive-sciences (Q147638, reviewed, currently 0 children). Gate scheme = LCC subclass BF (Psychology); contrasts = UDC 159.9 + MeSH tree F + OECD FORD 5.1 + Wikidata Q147638 P279/P527 hexagon (captured-sources.md, baseline 2026-06-18). Orchestrator pre-captured all series before generation (decision (30) NS precedent; (34) skeleton template). Cognitive science is interdisciplinary with no single gate — the generator anchors the discipline hierarchy on LCC BF / Q147638 and uses FORD/MeSH/UDC for corroboration only. The seed_entities list is the orchestrator's coverage target; the generator applies the section-12 skeleton standard to decide keep/absorb/level and flags boundary cases per the captured boundary table.

include: Cognitive-sciences field and subfield coverage skeleton (nodes only, level 1 field / level 2 subfield)

field:psychology (LCC BF1-990, UDC 159.9, FORD 5.1) as the anchor field; its branches as subfields (own LCC BF sub-range and/or UDC 159.9x division and/or MeSH F discipline + department/society/journal community presence)

field:neuroscience as a cogsci-owned field by institutional independence (Society for Neuroscience, dedicated departments/degrees) — no own LCC BF range; grounded via Wikidata Q207011 + RC321-571 (medicine) + QP (life sciences) cross-membership

Psychology subfields: cognitive, developmental, social, clinical, experimental, biological, personality, comparative, educational, industrial-and-organizational, health, evolutionary, psychometrics, sensation-and-perception, neuropsychology, abnormal, positive, forensic

Neuroscience subfields: cognitive-neuroscience, behavioral-neuroscience, computational-neuroscience, systems-neuroscience, affective-neuroscience (molecular/cellular = life-sciences home, section-13 only — not new cogsci nodes)
Integrative cognitive-science subfields: computational-cognitive-science (+ section-13 to CS), judgment-and-decision-making (section-12 overlap test vs subfield:decision-theory Q177571)
Wikidata QID resolution for identity and external_ids
exclude: Edges and relations (skeleton-first: dots before lines; part_of skeleton edges + section-13 are a separate batch)
Level-3 concepts (cognition, attention, memory, perception-as-percept, etc.), persons, works — and ALL researcher/clinician person nodes (living-person strict)

Re-proposing any existing /data node: domain:cognitive-sciences (Q147638), subfield:artificial-intelligence (Q11660), subfield:machine-learning (Q2539), subfield:human-computer-interaction (Q207434) [CS]; subfield:philosophy-of-mind (Q23407), subfield:philosophy-of-perception (Q3300457), subfield:philosophy-of-psychiatry (Q27333716), subfield:philosophy-of-cognitive-science (QID-less proposed), subfield:decision-theory (Q177571) [humanities]; field:psychiatry (Q7867), field:neurology (Q83042), subfield:neurosurgery (Q188449) [medicine]; field:anthropology (Q23404), subfield:cultural-anthropology (Q28598), subfield:physical-anthropology (Q27172) [SS]; subfield:developmental-biology (Q213713) [life sciences]

field:cognitive-science holding Q147638 — the DOMAIN already holds Q147638; do NOT duplicate the QID on a field node (decision (36) Q21198 de-duplication precedent). Cognitive-science-proper integrative content = subfields (cognitive-psychology, cognitive-neuroscience, computational-cognitive-science)
Linguistics / psycholinguistics / neurolinguistics / cognitive-linguistics (humanities-residual owns, next round — record only, do NOT build a linguistics wing)
psychiatry / neurology / clinical-neuroscience (medicine exists — section-13/adjacent edges only, separate task)
Parapsychology, occult sciences (LCC BF1001-2055) — pseudoscience objects, not cognitive-science disciplines; graphology/phrenology/physiognomy/palmistry (historical/non-academic, not cogsci-owned)
Disease/disorder nodes (MeSH F03 organ-of-the-mind disorders describe the object, not the discipline — model clinical-psychology, not 'anxiety disorder')

allowed_public_sources.notes: CC0. Resolver verifies the unverified training-knowledge QID hints in the proposal and fills missing QIDs. Cognitive-science homonym traps (Q9418 vs Q11633 'psychology' general entity; cognition/learning/memory general concepts vs disciplines; 'social psychology' vs 'sociology') — multi-signal, never label-match.
External-link / source-resolution pointer only. Never store or cache article bodies.

forbidden_sources.reason: External links only; never store article text or treat as primary evidence (project hard constraint).
No cloud LLM API calls, SDKs, or keys anywhere in repo tooling/build/CI (project hard constraint).
No scraping or crawling of third-party sites; resolvers use declared public APIs only.

notes: Gate = LCC subclass BF (captured 2026-06-18, captured-sources.md). Contrasts = UDC 159.9 + MeSH tree F + OECD FORD 5.1 + Wikidata Q147638 P279/P527 hexagon. PhySH absent for cognitive science (NS-only) — MeSH F is the discipline scheme. Cognitive science is interdisciplinary: anchor the hierarchy on LCC BF / Q147638; FORD 5.1 (a social science in Frascati) is contrast only — our model treats cognitive sciences as an independent continent.

Section-12 skeleton modeling standard (docs/data-foundry.md section 12) is a mandatory generator input. Dual criterion: (a) major division in a gate scheme (LCC BF sub-range / UDC 159.9x / MeSH F discipline) AND (b) department/society/journal/degree-track community presence. Absorb refinements of a kept node serving the same community (record as v2 re-split candidate). Flat two-level (field/subfield); edge depth is free.

Boundary pre-assignments + handoff table (captured-sources.md) are mandatory generator input. Cognitive science OWNS psychology (all branches) + neuroscience + integrative cognitive-science subfields. Do NOT create: AI/ML/HCI (CS), philosophy-of-mind/perception/psychiatry/cognitive-science (philosophy), psychiatry/neurology (medicine), linguistics/psycholinguistics/cognitive-linguistics (humanities-residual, next round — record only), anthropology (SS). Generation is cogsci; dual membership is section-13 (separate edge batch).

philosophy-of-cognitive-science (proposed, QID-less, humanities) is a resolution trigger on cogsci entry — review section-13 candidate on the philosophy-side node + promote if grounding mature (separate judgment; no forced promotion). The skeleton does NOT re-create it.
Living-person strict: discipline nodes only; no person nodes this round.

Tension preservation (decision (42)(43)): cognitive science is rich in competing paradigms (behaviorism vs cognitivism, symbolism vs connectionism, nature vs nurture, modularity vs embodiment). The A skeleton is part_of-primary; if proposition-edges arise, preserve opposing/minority views (disputed + note + co-existing edges), correct only identity-axis errors. Skeleton nodes themselves are non-disputed disciplines.

Cognitive-science QID homonym traps: Q9418 'psychology' (the science) vs other 'psychology' entities; cognition/learning/memory/attention general concepts (Q161p-class) vs the disciplines that study them; 'computational neuroscience' vs 'computational cognitive science' (distinct); resolver and QC use multi-signal triangulation (P31 academic discipline / field of study), never label-string matching. Hint-laundering machine sweep is mandatory at QC (sessions 8-19 pattern).
